data.gender_notes: Divyank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Divyank is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'divy,' meaning divine, godlike, and radiant. It is a name given to those who are considered to have a divine or godlike presence. In Hindu mythology, there is a god named Divya, who is the god of heaven and the god of light. The name Divyank carries the meaning “Divine, Godlike, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Divyank usually hope their child will grow to embody divine, godlike, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
